An open-source investigation agent built for alert-driven triage.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF Sandbox project, Apache 2.0: given an alert, the model chooses investigation tools (Kubernetes, Prometheus, logs, 30+ integrations) and follows Markdown runbooks to an explanation.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Agentic and multi-source, unlike k8sgpt's rule-based scan. STCLab cut manual triage from about 20 minutes to under 2 per alert, and found runbook quality mattered more than model choice.

WHERE WE STAND

Our stage-1 starting point, read-only, with Claude behind it. ⚠️ Confirm the current release and Claude support.

CNCF blog, April 2026; project documentation
